plan: Baseline: tests (11) and acceptance (8) all pass.
Contracts: the report-to-stock boundary is covered in qa/test_integration.py (remove, then report).
Integration: add, remove and report flow, an empty inventory, and the report not changing the inventory.
Acceptance: every AC in section 8 is covered by the existing acceptance tests, so I did not duplicate them.
Edge cases: non-string SKU, threshold of 0 or below, very large quantities, no state left after a failed call, and InsufficientStock not being a ValueError. All pass.
Regression: discarded, because no code existed before this architecture apart from the version test, which passes.
Non-functional: discarded, because the architecture sets no security or performance requirements.
Run again with: python3 -m unittest discover -s qa. No tests are left red on purpose.
gaps: Concurrency is out of scope in section 2, so it was not tested.
I did not run lint or type checks because section 3 names no tool for them.

advisory.problem: AC-003: the invalid-quantity cases run in nested loops without subTest. A failure doesn't say which qty or method broke, and the first failure stops the remaining cases. Detection is unaffected.
advisory.evidence: A stub that accepts only one invalid type still fails the test. This only affects how clear the failure message is.
